author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A Megabucks ticket sold in Holyoke won a record $29.71 million jackpot, according to the Massachusetts State Lottery. The ticket was purchased on Labor Day at King Mart, 494 Westfield Road, and matched the numbers 21, 28, 31, 34, 40 and 44.

The prize is the largest jackpot in the game’s history. The previous overall record was a $21.7 million jackpot in 1985 that was divided among eight winning tickets. The prior record for a single winning ticket was $16.35 million, claimed from a ticket sold in Ware in 2022.

The winner has one year from the drawing date to claim the prize. Lottery officials had not publicly identified the ticket holder in the report, and the existence of a winning ticket does not mean the prize has already been collected.

Large prizes can be claimed through the Massachusetts Lottery under its verification and payment procedures. Until that process is complete, the key confirmed detail is the point of sale: a Holyoke convenience store produced the ticket that reset the Megabucks record.
dek: The Labor Day ticket sold at King Mart matched all six numbers and surpassed the game’s previous single-ticket record.
headline: Holyoke ticket wins record $29.71 million Megabucks jackpot
